question: Estimate the size of the Indian Muslim consumer market (specific products + halal certified).
idealClarificationQuestions: Total Muslim consumer market in India? Yes.
Halal-specific + Eid-driven + Islamic banking/finance? Provide breakdown.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Muslim population × purchasing power × halal-specific share.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: - Islamic-compliant banking/finance (Shariah MF, Halal investments): ~₹8,000 Cr AUM.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Total Muslim consumer market in India

calculationFlow: Average per-capita consumer spend (slightly lower than national average due to socioeconomic distribution): ~₹50,000/year.
Total Muslim consumer market in India: 21 cr × ₹50,000 = ~₹10.5 lakh Cr.
- Eid/Ramadan festive retail spike: ~₹35,000 Cr seasonal.
- Islamic-compliant banking/finance (Shariah MF, Halal investments): ~₹8,000 Cr AUM.
